profile.headline: Flight Software Engineer | VAST
profile.summary: Flight Software Engineer at VAST working on the Haven-1 space station and satellite missions

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed software for the Haven Demo satellite mission, which successfully launched aboard the SpaceX Falcon 9 Bandwagon-4 rideshare.
positions.insights: Skills: Regression Testing · Sensors · Telemetry · HIL · Software Development · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Cruz, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed Mission Display Verification Framework for Joby S4 aircraft using Python to verify accurate data transmission between the mission display computer and flight sensors.
Implemented message streaming for continuous communication between mission displays and vehicle sensors.
positions.insights: Skills: Control Systems · REST APIs · Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · Testing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Automation

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed code for Operations Planning software using Python and REST APIs for Jeppesen Flight Algorithms. Implemented rules and penalties set by airline clients into the algorithm software to fit with the standards required by FAA.
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Git · Optimization · Python (Programming Language) · Testing

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Member
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Wrote altimeter firmware for the rocket's flight controller for Tangerine Space Machine.
Performed CFD Structure Stress simulations using ANSYS to test rocket fin elasticity.
positions.insights: Skills: Graphical User Interface (GUI) · Java · Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · Accelerometer

positions.title: Design Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Created utility maps on Microstation for senior engineers to successfully understand the surrounding geography for upcoming projects.
Learned how to effectively visualize designs and sketches and transfer them onto CAD softwares.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Performed tests in a laboratory that would determine the durability, density, airflow, and tensile strength of foam samples. 
Processed data into Excel sheets and wrote effective queries using SQL to extract required data needed by senior engineers.
Wrote Excel VBA code that increased foam sorting selection process by 10-15%.
positions.insights: Skills: CNC Operation · Microsoft Excel · Python (Programming Language) · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Avionics Team Member
positions.description: Worked closely with Avionics and Launch Operations team to develop data acquisition systems for major test events such as real-time monitoring and analysis of critical performance metrics on hot-fire tests.
positions.insights: Skills: MATLAB · C (Programming Language) · Problem Solving · C++ · Arduino · Team Building · Research

positions.title: Stock Associate
positions.description:
Helped organize and sort new shipment items.
Assisted customers around the store.
Worked the register and was responsible for counting money and processing transactions.

certifications.name: ESA Academy - Fly a Rocket Programme
certifications.title: ESA Academy - Fly a Rocket Programme

projects.title: Text-Based Wordle in C++
projects.description: This project is a recreation of the famous NYT game, Wordle, using C++  programming language. This C++ recreation replaces the colored boxes for Text-based responses.

projects.title: A*star Pathfinder Visual
projects.description:
Programmed a Pathfinder using the A* algorithm in python that finds the most efficient route between a starting node and end node while avoiding obstacles on a set grid.
Designed functionality that allowed users to customize the grid by placing a variety of different obstacles with different characteristics.
